title: The Barbarins: T-Boy and T-Gal
summary: He recalls piano players and the Barbarin family, T-Boy (Paul), his sister T-Gal and old man Barbarin.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I don't know, but many of them wake with...

A whole lot of those fellas I don't forget, Gusu and... Got some, huh? A whole gang of most everything, everything in that time, in that class. They're not a man of no kind. Piano players, no. Little Mikey died, two Mikey died. Wake with them. Bob ran, the weak head Bob ran out. Who is that?
T-Boy we called, what, Paul? Yeah. I said T-Boy, it's an old little kid name and stuff.
But Bob ran out, Paul Bob ran out, but we didn't say that. We said T-Boy Bob ran.
He was young then, huh? Mm-hmm.
Called him T-Boy and called his sister T-Gal. And the old man was always old man Bob ran. Even when he was young.
